seoTitle: How to Transfer Workspace Drive Files to Another Gmail
metaDescription: Learn how to move Google Drive files from a Workspace account to a personal Gmail account, using ownership transfer or Google Takeout.
intro: Whether you're switching jobs or backing up before closing a Workspace account, moving your Drive files to a personal Gmail account keeps your documents accessible. This guide covers ownership transfer, sharing, and Google Takeout as backup options.

steps.heading: Decide on your transfer method
steps.body: Choose between transferring file ownership directly, sharing and copying content, or using Google Takeout depending on how much data you're moving and whether full ownership transfer is allowed.

steps.heading: Transfer ownership where possible
steps.body: For files you can transfer directly, change the owner field to your personal Gmail account so it fully belongs to the new account.

steps.heading: Share and copy content as a backup approach
steps.body: If direct ownership transfer isn't available, share folders with your personal account and make copies of the files instead.

steps.heading: Use Google Takeout for bulk exports
steps.body: For large volumes of data, Google Takeout lets you export your entire Drive contents as a downloadable archive to re-upload elsewhere.

steps.heading: Confirm everything transferred successfully
steps.body: Check your personal Gmail's Drive to make sure all folders and files appear correctly before removing anything from the original Workspace account.

faq.question: Can I transfer Drive files directly between a Workspace and personal Gmail account?
faq.answer: In many cases yes, through ownership transfer, though some organization settings may restrict this and require the share-and-copy method instead.

faq.question: What is Google Takeout used for in this process?
faq.answer: Takeout exports your Drive data as a downloadable archive, which is especially useful for transferring large volumes of files or when ownership transfer isn't allowed.

faq.question: Will transferring files change their sharing permissions?
faq.answer: Ownership changes can affect who has access, so review sharing settings after the transfer to make sure the right people still have access.

faq.question: Is there a size limit to how much I can transfer at once?
faq.answer: Large transfers may take longer or need to be done in batches, especially when using Takeout for bulk exports.
